messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On behalf of the Amber development team, I am pleased to announce the release
of Amber22 and AmberTools22. Information is available here:
https://ambermd.org
and includes download information and a brief summary of new features.
Thanks to all who contributed, with kudos to Gerald Monard, Scott Brozell,
Dan Roe and Stephan Schott (among others) for final testing.
...dac
